description: This file defines a repository class that provides access to media items and related data such as tabs and genres for a media application.

classes.name: SampleRepository
classes.description: A repository class managing media items, tabs, and genres for the app.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns a list of tab items for navigation.

methods.name: featured
methods.description: Returns the first media item as a featured item.

methods.name: genreRows
methods.description: Returns genre-specific rows with filtered media items, including fallback if no items match.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a media item by its unique identifier.
